description: Database schema integrity — every event type has a matching table write, every table is reachable from at least one event, all migrations apply + rollback cleanly. Use to gate schema changes before merge.

gates.name: schema.eventToTableParity
gates.description: Every zod event variant must have a matching table write. Numerator: schema.eventTypesWithTableWrite ; denominator: schema.eventTypes.

gates.name: schema.tableReachability
gates.description: Every table must be reachable from at least one event (or have a documented exception via SCHEMA-TABLEREACHABILITY-EXEMPT). schema.tablesReached / schema.tables ≥ 0.9.

gates.name: schema.migrationRoundtripPassed
gates.description: All drizzle migrations must apply cleanly (and ideally rollback). Record `1` per migration that round-tripped clean.

gates.name: claims.validatedRatio
gates.description: Every reported bug must have been re-validated by claim-validator before clôture.
